description: This file declares the SignalFd class used for handling signal file descriptors within the cuttlefish process sandboxer component. It provides methods to create a SignalFd instance excluding SIGCHLD, read signals, and access the file descriptor.

classes.name: SignalFd
classes.description: A class encapsulating a signal file descriptor, providing methods to create an instance excluding SIGCHLD, read signals, and retrieve the file descriptor.

methods.name: AllExceptSigChld
methods.description: Creates a SignalFd instance that monitors all signals except SIGCHLD.

methods.name: ReadSignal
methods.description: Reads the next signal from the file descriptor.
